_comment: Engine hubs. One page per engine is generated to workshops/engine-<id>.html from this config joined with content/workshops.json. Every workshop id appears in exactly one section, so nothing is repeated on the page. Sections are ordered top to bottom; install=true marks a section that needs the free desktop app, install=false marks one that runs in the browser with nothing to install. titles, links, difficulty and age always come from the workshop data. Add an engine block and run: node scripts/generate-engine-hubs.js

engines.name: Godot
engines.tagline: A free engine for 2D and 3D games, coded in GDScript.
engines.lumo: New to Godot? Start with the two no-install builds at the top. When you want a real game, pick one of the browser or app projects below.
engines.pip: Finished the starter builds? Pick a game below, or try one that runs straight in the browser.
engines.install: Godot is a free download and needs no account. The browser builds need nothing installed, so you can start on any school computer.

notes.godot-gdscript-essentials-canvas: The GDScript basics as a build-along you run in the browser, so you can start with nothing installed.
notes.godot-tutorial-canvas: Your first scene and moving object, built step by step in the browser.
notes.godot-platformer-canvas: A jump-and-run platformer you build, then play, in the browser.
notes.godot-puzzle-canvas: A small puzzle game with your own tiles and rules, built in the browser.
notes.godot-racing-canvas: A top-down racing game you steer with the arrow keys, built in the browser.
notes.godot-racing-2-canvas: Add laps, obstacles and a finish line to the browser racing game you started.
notes.godot-gatekeeper-3d-part1-canvas: The first half of a 3D checkpoint game, built in the browser.
notes.godot-gatekeeper-3d-part2-canvas: Part two of the 3D checkpoint game: extra rules and a night shift, built in the browser.

engines.name: Scratch
engines.tagline: The friendly drag-and-drop coding language. Games are made by snapping blocks together, and everything runs in the browser.
engines.lumo: Brand new to coding? Start with My First Scratch Game. Then build a game right here in the page, where you can watch it run as you go.
engines.pip: Every project here runs in the browser, so there is nothing to install. Pick a game and build it.
engines.install: Scratch runs in the browser, so nothing needs installing and no account is needed to start a build here.

notes.my-first-scratch-game-canvas: The first game, built step by step inside this page, so you can start with nothing installed.
notes.scratch-catch-canvas: Build the fruit catch game inside the page: move the basket, catch the fruit and add a score.
notes.scratch-platformer-canvas: Build the side-scrolling platformer inside the page: gravity, jumping, platforms and coins.
notes.scratch-maze-canvas: Build the maze inside the page: draw the walls, collect the keys and reach the exit.
notes.scratch-quiz-canvas: Build the quiz inside the page: ten questions, a timer and a score.
notes.scratch-clicker-canvas: Build the idle clicker inside the page: click for coins, buy upgrades and add auto-earners.
notes.scratch-pong-canvas: Build the classic two-paddle Pong game inside the page.
